heading: Liji 23 · Jing Jie 經解 · The Different Teaching Of The Different Kings · Jing Jie 8 … Jing Jie 9

items.text: Observe the ceremonies of marriage, that the path of husband and wife be not embittered.
items.quote: If the ceremonies of marriage were discontinued, the path of husband and wife would be embittered

items.text: Observe the drinking ceremonies at country feasts, maintaining order between old and young.
items.quote: If the drinking ceremonies at country feasts were discontinued, the order between old and young would be neglected

items.text: Perform the ceremonies of mourning and sacrifice, not revolting from the observances due to the dead.
items.quote: there would be numerous cases in which there was a revolt from the observances due to the dead
items.conflict: Reformed Christians honor the dead but do not worship ancestors; ceremonies must not become worship of spirits.

items.text: Keep the observances due to the living, not letting them be forgotten.
items.quote: and an oblivion of those due to the living

items.text: Regulate your family by the rules of propriety, so that affection and harmony prevail.
items.quote: when the family is regulated by them, there is affection between father and son, and harmony among brothers

items.text: Cultivate affection with your son, as propriety requires.
items.quote: when the family is regulated by them, there is affection between father and son, and harmony among brothers

items.text: Cultivate affection with your father, as propriety requires.
items.quote: when the family is regulated by them, there is affection between father and son, and harmony among brothers
when the family is regulated by them, there is affection between father and son, and harmony among brothers

items.text: Offer mourning and sacrifice with kindly feeling toward your departed father.
items.quote: those of mourning and sacrifice, to illustrate the kindly feelings of ministers and sons
items.conflict: Ancestor worship and sacrifice to the dead are forbidden: worship God alone.
